doc: A YAML stream of three documents read with body.stream documents (FBL 0.22, section 4.3): the first document has no --- line, a comment and a blank line stand before the second document's --- line and so belong to the first, and the second ends with a ... marker, which belongs to it. Each document is an entry of the sequence at the root, so the rules at /* read one element per document, in the body's order. Without stream, only the service would be read. ../yaml-stream-edits/ edits the same body.
